definition: Projected radius from the M33 centre reached by the low-surface-brightness red-giant substructure around its disc in the Pan-Andromeda Archaeological Survey.
quote: The structure extends to projected radii of ~40 kpc from the center of M33
presentation: Where the galaxy's stars are still measured: while the camera is inside this radius the galaxy's caption hides; outside it the caption hangs under what is drawn of the galaxy. Not a boundary.
